title: IVG 2400 Reload Mango Edition Prefilled Vape Pods - 20mg - 4PK
description: Designed for use with the IVG 2400 Reload Prefilled Pod Kit, these IVG 2400 Reload Prefilled Pods provide an easy way to keep your device filled with bright and tropical flavours. Each pack contains four individual 2ml prefilled pods, delivering up to 2400 puffs per kit (depending on personal usage) while ensuring smooth and consistent vapour production. The Mango Edition features a collection of mango-inspired blends, combining smooth, juicy, and tropical fruit notes for a well-balanced vape: Mango Banana – A creamy fusion of ripe Mango and smooth Banana for a tropical fruit medley. Mango Pineapple Peach – A bright and refreshing combination of sweet Mango, tangy Pineapple, and soft Peach. Triple Mango – A bold and concentrated Mango blend that amplifies the fruit’s naturally sweet and tangy characteristics. Mango – A pure and authentic Mango flavour that captures the essence of freshly sliced tropical fruit. Swapping pods is effortless—just replace an empty pod with a fresh one and continue enjoying your vape. Whether you're looking for an easy way to refresh your device or a simple alternative to disposables, these pods provide a mess-free and reliable vaping solution.
